# Why do children get the flu vaccine at school? {background-image="figs/background1.png"}

## Who has had the little nose spray?

👦

↓

👦 👧 👦 👧

↓

🏠 Families

↓

👵 Grandparents

::: fragment
Children are very good at sharing germs!
:::

::: fragment
Vaccination slows the spread.
:::

::: fragment
Protecting one person helps protect many others.
:::

::: fragment
My work helped provide scientific evidence used by experts when considering the UK's school flu programme.
:::
